verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a business formation, compliance and bookkeeping service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's data. Pulse's bookkeeping automation and expense monitoring, the compliance calendar, and the Formation MCP server (which lets an external AI client form an LLC) are adjacent features that do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
